book.name: 1 Korin
book.title: 1 Korin Pol re Korin kwomri tatame remne kiyi basrasem siglow

content: Pol re Jerusalemke newopitite kelri tuma wem.

Kiyi kemri anne wemetem tuma an kemne sein wete nenbo. Krais reri Judia nowselke tetane tatame remne kem kwobo late selbo, kem kel wuriwouke bogte. Ari Galesia nowselke tetane God reri tatame remne wemkap, kem etop nente. An etop selbo.
Kem God rene lom yokwobo yabel wulare wulare, kem kel raste. Kem kel potbokap, kem habon kerakera kena rasbet. Opkap an yate yabel kem agerbo kel sene be raste.
An kemne lasyate, an kemri lebam tame remne webo tuma basrasem siglow newote, rem kemri rasem kelkene sen Jerusalemke yite.
Kap an Jerusalemke kirkir yite habote, rem arenkene etep yite.
Pol re Korin kwomri tatame remne late selem.
An Masedonia yokwok kiyi yite, yuri an kemne ek yan late.
Liyp rane an kemkene tete. Kap, an worwu keremkene temente. Opkap an map yokwok yite wete, kem anne kwobo late.
An yate, an selbo, an agerbo kwom agetage be yite. Haneyen eterri wos. Re wete, rane liyp an keremkene temente.
An Efesuske ten yin God Reri Wow Yerem Yabel tete.
God re anne yaku bukre gwotek nente wem, eker an gwotek nenbo. Ari nenbo yaku nugwape tatame rem sewaibo, an remri webo tuma be metbo. An er yaku som nenbo.
Kap, Timoti re kemne lasyate, kem rene heyar poten pap yewote, re keremkene heyar temente. An God reri yaku nenbokap, Timoti re etopwou nenbo.

Re yate, kemri yike wuri rene kap op wete. Re tame bukre bo. Re muyensi yen tame. Re keremkene temente, kem rene heyar lakerete. Yuri re anne sene lasyate, kem reri kelow kwobo late. Jisas rene habobo gesmase rem yate, re kirkir etemkene yate. An etop kowtene.

An nemri mase, Apolos, rene wete nenbo. An rene tewok tewok op webem. Ne rane gesmase remkene Korin tatame remne lasyite. Op webem, re sein op webem. Gwopte an be yite. God re kirkir be wetene. Yuri, God re kirkir wetek, re kemne lasyate.
Rane tuma tep tetane.
Kem le kap sate, kem ei si. Kem murese omuteke habobet. Kem molkene te. Kem kitimenakene te.
Kem God rene pap yewobokap kem tatame remne kirkir heyar pap yewote. Be wos kem nente, kem pap yewobo wulek nente.
Kem Stefanes rene yentakene mettene. Rem Akaia yokwok temenem. Re reri yentakene rem Jisas rene kiyi omuteke habom. Rem etemri wuribaike rem God reri tatame remne kwobo labem.
Gesmase. An kemne omuteke webo. Kem aboyei etopkap tame etemri kulke tete. Etemkene yaku yenbo nenbo tame etemri kulke kirkir tete.
Stefanas, Fortunatus, Akaikus rem anne lasyam, an okbop bukre tem. Kem anne kwobo kebese be lam, etem rem anne kwobo lam.
Rem yam, an pap kwuye metem. Kerem mere, kem kirkir pap kwuye metem. Opkap tame yenbo kem remri sig bukre wete.
Esia yokwori Jisas rene habobo tatame rem kemne pir webo. Akwilakene Prisilakene repri akek duwen Jisas rene habobo tatame etem mere, rem kemne pir webo.
Gwok tetane gesmase rem aboyei kemne pir webo. Kem Jisas rene habobo tatame remne late, kem remne Haneyen Jisas eterri sigke remne let keren ragi boite.
An Pol, areri letke an kersep poten kemne pir webo tuma basrasbo.
Tatame rem Haneyen rene omuteke be habote, God re remne yaper nente. Haneyen, ne ya.
Haneyen Jisas re kemne pap meten kwobo late.
Krais Jisas eterke an kemne pap yewobo.
